title: Keep Resume delivery conflicts tied to the admitted prompt after successor replacement
outcome: A Resume delivery that holds one admitted prompt never reports a successor's durability hold as that prompt's failure after Cancel or replacement; exact owner and Scheduled/Superseded behavior stay intact.
acceptance: The post-delivery Resume refusal checks only the admitted prompt identity, or an equivalent current-owner fence, before using a durability refusal; a successor's save state cannot become its conflict text.
Deterministic owner-bound and ordinary Resume tests cover Cancel or successor replacement between delivery and the final check, preserving the successor and causing no extra provider handoff.
Credited focused tests pass on the final source, and the independent review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher findings.
